en.title: Minimum Health When Armor Can Be Used Once
en.description:
You take each round of damage in order, and your health must always stay strictly greater than 0. In one round you may use the armor, which blocks min(armor, damage this round) points of damage. Find the minimum initial health.

Standard input/output, examples and judging were written independently by CSWork; conventions marked as this site's do not claim to be the source's original limits.
en.input: The first line contains n armor (1≤n≤100000, 1≤armor≤10⁹); the second line contains n damage values (1..10⁹).
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: Example 1: the total damage is 16 and the armor blocks 5, leaving 11 damage, so the initial health must be 12. Example 2: the armor blocks the only 1 point of damage, so an initial health of 1 is enough. Example 3: after blocking 1, the total damage is 9, so 10 is needed.
hints: Subtract the most that can be blocked, min(armor,max(power)), from the total damage, then add 1.
